integrity: The proof separates standard center facts from the Fraïssé-limit deductions. Finite computation checks only local algebraic lemmas and finite support classification; the infinite theorem is proved from universality and ultrahomogeneity.
scientific_limitations: The dense restriction homomorphism is not proved injective or surjective.
The exact orbit formula concerns tuples lying entirely in the Boolean center.
The Boolean orbit profile is classical in substance; novelty is claimed for its realization through the center action and dense restriction.
An equivalent short formulation may exist as unindexed folklore.
title: The Boolean center of the universal homogeneous Heyting algebra is atomless, with dense automorphism shadow
